categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in manufacturing and sales of steel products including steel rods (盤元), spheroidized wire rods, hot-dip galvanized wire, galvanized wire, black iron wire, screws, and also operates in the hospitality sector. The business segments include steel production, metal plastic processing (screws), and hospitality services. The company also provides OEM services and has diversified investments in related industries such as cement, securities, leisure hotels, and bicycles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced steel rolling and processing technologies including spheroidizing heat treatment, hot-dip galvanizing, electro-galvanizing, and wire drawing. Production processes cover steel billet grinding, rolling, annealing, acid pickling, galvanizing, and screw manufacturing with integrated heat treatment and surface finishing. Continuous equipment upgrades and process improvements focus on environmental protection, quality enhancement, and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic construction, machinery, automotive, hardware, and electronics industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with exports primarily to Japan, the United States, Europe, Southeast Asia, Australia, China, Myanmar, and India. The domestic market accounts for approximately 89% of sales, while exports represent about 11%. Major customers include distributors and manufacturers in steel and hardware sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are mainly concentrated in Taiwan, with manufacturing facilities located in Tainan City. Export markets include Japan, the United States, Europe, Southeast Asia, Australia, China, Myanmar, and India. The company maintains a strong domestic presence while actively expanding its overseas market share.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the steel supply chain. It produces steel billets and wire rods (midstream) and further processes these into finished products such as screws and galvanized wires (downstream). It also provides OEM manufacturing services, positioning itself close to end-users in construction and manufacturing industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include increasing production capacity utilization and product quality to reduce costs, expanding sales of construction screws and metal plastic processing products, and maintaining a dedicated steel rolling technology team. R&D focuses on environmental protection, process optimization, product quality improvement, and development of high-value-added products such as alloy and specialty steels. The company also emphasizes talent recruitment and training, equipment modernization, and expanding export markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of steel rods, wire rods, galvanized wires, screws, and related steel products. Additional income comes from OEM manufacturing services and hospitality operations. The company also earns investment income from diversified subsidiaries and associates.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include domestic steel manufacturers such as China Steel Corporation, Feng Hsing Steel, Long Ching Steel, Ye Hsing Steel, Yi Sheng Steel, and Wei Zhi Steel, as well as importers and traders from countries like Indonesia, South Korea, Vietnam, Japan, China, India, Russia, Thailand, and Saudi Arabia. The company leverages its scale, quality focus, flexible delivery, and R&D capabilities to maintain a competitive position in the domestic steel wire and screw markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024 (fiscal year 113), the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$3.28 billion, representing an 8% increase from the previous year. Operating profit improved significantly with a gross profit of NT$175.8 million compared to a loss the prior year. Net income was NT$164.2 million, reversing previous losses. Total assets reached NT$13.2 billion, with equity of NT$7 billion. The company shows a positive growth trajectory supported by increased sales volume, price improvements, and investment in production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, flexible and customized delivery, and competitive pricing supported by long-term supplier relationships and scale economies. It differentiates through integrated production processes from steel billets to finished screws, enabling cost control and quality consistency. Continuous R&D and process improvements enhance product performance and environmental compliance, while strong customer service and stable partnerships reinforce market competitiveness.
